study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized resting-state functional connectivity abnormalities unveil two major depressive disorder subtypes with contrasting abnormal patterns of abnormality

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Nonparametric two-sided tolerance intervals were used to define normative ranges for each functional connection based on healthy controls (R tolerance package).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we used the "tolerance" package in R (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/tolerance/tolerance.pdf) to estimate nonparametric two-sided tolerance intervals for each functional connection in HCs.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Fang2025.pdf.md: MATERIALS AND METHODS / Identifying extreme functional connections in MDD

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Resting-state functional connectivity derived from pairwise Pearson correlations between regional time courses (200 x 200 FC matrix, Fisher Z-transformed).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Functional networks were estimated by calculating pairwise Pearson's correlation coefficients between regional signals, with the resulting values transformed to Fisher's Z scores. This procedure produced a 200 × 200 functional connectivity matrix for each participant.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Fang2025.pdf.md: MATERIALS AND METHODS / Functional connectivity features and harmonization
